| parse field=iis_log_message "ArrivalRate = \"*\";" as ArrivalRate nodrop
| parse field=iis_log_message "CacheHitRate = \"*\";" as CacheHitRate nodrop
|	parse field=iis_log_message "CurrentQueueSize = *;" as CurrentQueueSize nodrop
